score_prompts: score probabilities of specified token IDs after each full prompt string or token sequence
score_request: score token ID probabilities for query-item pairs with optional embedding overrides and softmax normalization
create_ScoreResult: create a ScoreResult dataclass with per-item scores, prompt token count, and optional pooled hidden states
build_multi_item_token_sequence: build a combined token sequence with delimiter tokens for multi-item scoring
process_single_item_scoring_results: process generation and classification model scoring results into ScoreResult objects
